test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A reduction of 12(1)/(2) % in the price of an item enables a person to buy 2.5 kg more for Rs. 280. The reduced price of the item per kg is:
solution:
**Given**

Percentage of price reduced = 12.5%

Quantity of buying increased = 2.5 kg

**Concept**

Price per Kg = Total amount/Quantity(in Kg)

**Calculation**

Let the quantity purchased for Rs 280 is x kg

Price = 280/x

New price = [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)]

New quantity purchased at reduced price = (x + 2.5)kg

According to question

 [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ [(280/x) - (35/x)] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ [(280 - 35)/x] × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ (245/x) × (x + 2.5) = 280

⇒ (245x + 612.5)/x = 280

⇒ 245x + 612.5 = 280x

⇒ 612.5 = 280x - 245x

⇒ 612.5 = 35x

⇒ 612.5/35 = x

⇒ 17.5 = x

New price = [(280/x) - 12.5% of (280/x)]

⇒ [(280/17.5) - 12.5% of (280/17.5)]

⇒ 16 - 12.5% of 16

⇒ 16 - 2

⇒ 14

**∴ Reduced price is Rs.14 per kg.**
